tests.name: Application initialization
tests.description: Application initializes correctly with proper screen dimensions and grid size

tests.name: Player movement
tests.description: Player can move in all four directions (up, down, left, right)

tests.name: Log physics
tests.description: Logs move correctly at their configured speeds

tests.name: Player on log movement
tests.description: Player moves with the log when riding it

tests.name: Water collision/death
tests.description: Player dies when positioned in water without a log

tests.name: Boundary death
tests.description: Player dies when going off-screen (left or right)

tests.name: Goal reaching
tests.description: Player wins when reaching the top row (goal)

tests.name: Game reset
tests.description: Game state resets correctly after game over

tests.name: Extended runtime
tests.description: Application runs for extended duration (60 seconds simulation) without crashing

tests.name: Rendering
tests.description: Rendering executes without errors using SDL dummy driver

tests.name: Full game cycle
tests.description: Complete game cycle from start to game over completes successfully

tests.name: Score tracking
tests.description: Score tracking works correctly when reaching the goal

observations: All core game mechanics function correctly
No crashes during extended runtime testing
Pygame 2.6.1 is properly installed and compatible
notes: All tests were performed using SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy for headless execution. The application successfully runs all core game logic including player movement, log physics, collision detection, win/lose conditions, and game state management.
